pooling: models.dinov2_backbone.pool_cls_plus_mean_patch (CLS ++ mean patch, registers excluded), fp32 compute, fp16 stored
purpose: XD-Violence extra TRAINING videos only; never evaluation; labels mapped by name to UCF classes
sampling_rule: candidates = every 5th decoded frame; 8 distinct seeded picks, ascending; repeat-cycle if fewer; frames JPEG round-tripped at q95 like the UCF extraction
seed_rule: per-video default_rng(first 4 bytes of sha256('<seed>:<file name>'))
